entity.description: A raw attendance event of an employment: in or out at an instant (punchDate), the zone it was read in and its local time as the source gave it, its source (AttendanceSource: the person's own clock, a device file, the kiosk), the source system and its own key for the event, the import it came in and the user who recorded it. sourceKey is unique, so an event recorded again is ignored. Never changed or deleted: a correction is a record of its own.

field.name: attendanceDayId
field.description: The day it counts on: its own day, or for an out-punch the day of the in-punch it closes

field.name: directionEnumId
field.description: AttendanceDirection: in or out

field.description: The IANA zone the time was read in

field.description: The source's own identity of the event, when it has one

field.name: sourceKey
field.description: Unique: the source, the employer, the source system and the event's key (or, for a file without one, the worker, instant and direction); a self-service punch's operation

field.name: facilityId

field.name: kioskBadgeId
field.description: The badge a kiosk punch's worker was identified by

mantle.party.PartySettingType.description: People - Employees clock in and out

entity.description: An employment's day of attendance, one a day (attendanceDate in the zone of the employment's working schedule, else the recorder's, timeZone): what its punches say, refreshed as they come (the first in, the last out, how many, the minutes between paired punches, and the flags MISSING_OUT, MISSING_IN and REPEATED), and its state (AttendanceDayStatus: from the punches, a correction asked, corrected). A corrected day's minutes are its approved correction's (attendanceCorrectionId); the punches stay as they were.

field.name: punchedMinutes
field.description: The minutes between the day's paired punches

field.name: workedMinutes
field.description: The day's minutes: the approved correction's, else the punches'

field.name: flagsText
field.description: What the punches lack, comma separated: MISSING_OUT, MISSING_IN, REPEATED

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: AttendanceDayStatus

field.name: attendanceCorrectionId
field.description: The approved correction in effect

entity.description: A correction of an employment's day: the intervals worked that day (AttendanceCorrectionInterval), their minutes, the reason, who asked and when, and its state (AttendanceCorrectionStatus: waiting for approval, approved, refused, withdrawn). It waits for a People approval of kind PakAttendance (PeopleApproval, bound to the correction's revision); approved, it is the day's attendance. The punches it corrects are never changed.

field.name: departmentPartyId
field.description: The employment's department on the day, which approval routing reads

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: AttendanceCorrectionStatus

entity.description: An interval worked on a corrected day, fromDate to thruDate (an interval may end the next day: an overnight shift counts on the day it starts).

A file of attendance events read for an employer (TimeImport): its name, the source system, the zone its times are in, how a worker is named (workerIdKind: partyId, People's person id, or workEmail) and the columns read, its state (AttendanceImportStatus: previewed, imported) and its counts. Its rows are AttendanceImportRow. Admin's Imports lists it through the time-and-attendance transfer target's find service.

field.name: mappingJson
field.description: The columns read: worker, time, direction, key and device

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: AttendanceImportStatus

field.name: skippedCount
field.description: Rows already recorded (a known source key) or repeated in the file

entity.description: A row of an attendance file: its line, the values read (worker, time, direction, the event's key, the device), what they were resolved to (the person, the employment, the direction, the instant, the source key) and its outcome: ready, known (the source key is recorded already), duplicate (repeated in the file), refused (with its reason code and message), imported (with its punch) or failed.

A clocking badge of an employment: an opaque number printed once as a barcode and kept only as its hash (tokenHash, unique), and the worker's own PIN kept only as its argon2 hash (pinHash, with pinSetDate), which the worker sets in self-service: until then the badge works at no kiosk. Issued by an HR editor of the employer, which revokes the employment's badge before it, with a one-time PIN or none (oneTimePinHash: it only lets the worker set their first PIN, and never works at a kiosk); HR resets a forgotten PIN the same way. The number is made when its issuer prints it, once, within fifteen minutes of the issue. A wrong PIN counts on the badge (failedCount), and enough of them lock it for a while (lockedUntilDate), each lockout twice as long as the one before (lockCount) until a right PIN; twenty wrong PINs within a day (since HR last reset the PIN, pinResetDate) stop it (disabledDate) until HR resets its PIN or issues a new badge. A right PIN clears the count and the lockouts. Revoked, it is refused at every kiosk; it is never deleted.

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: The employment

field.name: tokenHash
field.description: The single-use hash of the badge's number, empty until printed

field.name: pinHash
field.description: The argon2 hash of the worker's own PIN, empty until they set it

field.name: pinSetDate
field.description: When the worker set their own PIN: the badge works at a kiosk only since

field.name: oneTimePinHash
field.description: The argon2 hash of the one-time PIN HR gave, if any, which the worker types once to set their own; never accepted at a kiosk

field.name: printedDate
field.description: When its number was made and printed

field.name: failedCount
field.description: Wrong PINs since the last right one

field.name: lockCount
field.description: Lockouts since the last right PIN: the next lasts 15 minutes doubled this many times

field.name: disabledDate
field.description: When twenty wrong PINs within a day stopped the badge: it works nowhere until HR resets its PIN or issues a new badge

field.name: pinResetDate
field.description: When HR last reset the PIN: wrong PINs before it no longer count toward the day's limit

entity.description: A refused proof at a clocking kiosk: the device, when, why (reasonCode: BADGE_UNKNOWN, BADGE_REVOKED, BADGE_DISABLED, PIN_WRONG, PIN_LIMITED, PIN_NOT_SET, ...) and the badge when one was read; a wrong PIN typed in self-service is one too, with no device, so a badge's wrong PINs of a day are counted wherever they were typed. Kept in a transaction of its own, so the refusal is counted although the punch is not recorded; a device with many refusals in a short time checks its next proofs only after a growing pause, and a burst of them tells the employer's HR. Pruned after 90 days (KioskIdentity's prune#KioskAttempts job).
When a clocking device's burst of refused proofs was last told to its employer's HR, so it is told at most once an hour (KioskIdentity.js).
